why: What GitHub's Actions settings, environments, secrets and variables for this repository are meant to be. scripts/deploy/Check-GitHubSettings.ps1 reads GitHub and names every difference (#3534); a change to a setting is a pull request to this file and the change on GitHub together. docs/RUNNER-ISOLATION.md section 1 says why each is what it is; Developer-Guide.md section P and docs/OWNERSHIP.md say what each secret is. Names only, never a value.
